subject: Private VPC pricing qualification - FintechCo (token volumes & licensing)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@fintechco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 15:02:00 +0000
Subject: Private VPC pricing qualification - FintechCo (token volumes & licensing)

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and a few asks so we can put together a Private/VPC pricing proposal that matches your goals: 

- Goal: Private VPC deployment for production fraud-check pipeline (low-latency inference, customer data stays in VPC).
- Key inputs we need to finalize pricing:
  1) Expected token volumes (monthly and peak), ideally 12-month forecast or bucketed ranges.
  2) Target unit economics (you mentioned wanting ~ $X / 1M tokens — can you confirm target $/1M tokens?).
  3) Budget range for the platform (annual committed spend or monthly commit).
  4) Environment count (how many separate environments: dev/staging/prod, number of replicas per env).
  5) Preferred licensing model: term/commit (reserved capacity + license) vs subscription (all-in usage).

Attached is our latest pricing worksheet (RIF-pricing-sheet-v3.xlsx) and a high-level SLA/options doc. If you can share an approximate month-1 / month-12 token estimate and procurement contact (PO/SOW cadence), we’ll put together 2 pricing options: a license + support tier model and an all-in subscription model with unit token economics called out.

Next step: once we have the numbers, I’ll loop in our Solutions lead (Marissa) to draft the licensing options and environment sizing.

Thanks,
Ben
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: RIF-pricing-sheet-v3.xlsx, Private-VPC-SLA-options.pdf

From: Alex Rivera <alex@fintechco.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Cho <sam.cho@fintechco.com>
Date: Sat, 26 Jun 2027 13:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Private VPC pricing qualification - FintechCo (token volumes & licensing)

Ben —

Thanks for the clear list. See our answers below: 

1) Token volumes: Our initial production worker will process ~200M tokens/month by month 3, ramping to ~1.2B tokens/month by month 12. Peak daily bursts could be ~100M tokens on big batch days.
2) Target unit economics: We’re aiming for ~ $900 / 1M tokens (cost to us including infra + service). If you can show Redwood pricing that lets us stay under $900/1M on modeled throughput, that’ll be ideal.
3) Budget: For year-1 platform + licensing we have a budget range of $250k — $750k depending on licensing structure and support SLAs.
4) Environments: We expect 3 main environments (dev, staging, prod). Prod will require 2 active replicas; staging 1 replica; dev can be small/spot.
5) Licensing model: Leadership prefers a reserved capacity + license model for predictability, but open to subscription if the unit economics work (and there’s a clear cost cap).

Procurement contact is Sam Cho (sam.cho@fintechco.com) — he handles PO/SOW/contracting. I attached a short procurement note.

Happy to chat if anything above needs clarification.

—Alex
Head of ML Engineering | FintechCo

Attachments: FintechCo-procurement-info.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Rivera <alex@fintechco.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Jun 2027 10:15:00 +0000
Subject: Fwd: Private VPC pricing qualification - FintechCo (token volumes & licensing)

Marissa / Monica —

Forwarding Alex’s answers from FintechCo (see below). Key asks for the pricing doc:
- Target $/1M tokens goal: $900
- Year-1 budget range: $250k — $750k
- Expected ramp: 200M/mo (M3) -> 1.2B/mo (M12); peaks ~100M/day
- Envs: dev/staging/prod; prod = 2 replicas, staging = 1, dev = small
- Procurement contact: Sam Cho (sam.cho@fintechco.com)

Please draft two options we can send to Alex and Sam:
Option A: Reserved license + support tiers (Bronze/Silver/Gold). Call out per-env license, per-replica cost, and an annual committed token band with overage rates. Highlight discounts for 12-month commit and bundling with Dedicated capacity.
Option B: Subscription (usage-first) with explicit $/1M token pricing at different volume bands and a soft cost cap option. Show modeled cost for month 3 and month 12 given their ramp.

Priority: make sure Option A hits predictable predictable costs inside their budget at the mid-point (~$500k/yr) while showing path to sub-$900/1M economics at scale.

Also include recommended support tier and time-to-setup notes: Private VPC typically ~6–8 weeks from SOW sign assuming network prep completed; call out additional cost for on-prem or air-gapped variants.

Thanks — I’ll review before we send.

Ben

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex@fintechco.com>, Sam Cho <sam.cho@fintechco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 16:30:00 +0000
Subject: Private VPC pricing options (reserved vs subscription) — initial estimate

Hi Alex / Sam —

Attached is an initial pricing package based on the numbers you shared (RIF-pricing-sheet-v3.xlsx). High-level summary:

Option A — Reserved license + support (recommended for predictability)
- 12-mo commit, annual license for Private VPC + reserved GPU pool sized for 1.2B tokens/month peak (2-prod replicas sizing).
- Estimated list: $620k/yr before negotiation (includes Bronze support).
- Modeled unit cost at M12 (1.2B tokens): ~$760 / 1M tokens. Modeled unit cost at M3 (200M tokens): ~$2,800 / 1M tokens (front-loaded infra).
- Overage: $1,200 / 1M tokens above committed band.

Option B — Subscription (usage-first)
- No long-term license; pay per-token bands with volume discounts.
- Modeled tiered pricing: $1,800 / 1M (0–250M), $1,100 / 1M (250–1,000M), $700 / 1M (1,000M+).
- Estimated year-1 cost (based on ramp to 1.2B): ~$540k. Can include a soft cap at $750k for additional fee.

Support tiers (add-ons):
- Bronze: Standard business hours, basic incident response (included in Option A list price).
- Silver: 24x7 on-call, faster SLAs, two scheduled quarterly reviews (add ~15% to list).
- Gold: Dedicated TAM, prioritized engineering support, runbooks & on-site options (add ~30% and requires contract addendum).

Environment & setup notes:
- We’ve sized 3 envs (dev/staging/prod) with 2 active prod replicas. Private VPC install + network review: estimate 6–8 weeks from SOW sign.

Next steps:
1) Confirm whether you prefer Option A or B (or want a hybrid).
2) If Option A, confirm support tier (Bronze/Silver/Gold) and we’ll draft SOW + purchase order guidance.
3) If Option B, confirm whether you want the soft cap and which bands to prioritize.

I can schedule a short call with Marissa (solutions) to walk the numbers and sizing next week.

Thanks,
Ben
Senior AE | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Attachments: RIF-pricing-sheet-v3.xlsx, Private-VPC-SLA-options.pdf

Sam, I’ve looped you for procurement next steps. Can you coordinate availability for a brief call with Redwood (Ben + Marissa) next week to sign off on support tier and SOW timeline?
